title: First Steps
subtitle: Hemolysis and the choice to begin
text: The Hemolytic Solution is the foundation. Brewed from dicentra sap and still water, it does not destroy the infection outright — nothing so direct would work. It creates a hostile environment within the blood, a gentle chemical cold that the mycelium dislikes. Sleep with it active. Work with it in your veins. Let the quiet of the night become a ritual of slow refusal. The blood will resist. It will feel like losing something. That is correct. You are.
